about_short_description.short_description: NKN Media is a media outsourcing company that offers advertising, digital marketing, and radio marketing services.

product.name: Television Advertising
product.description: A service that facilitates advertising campaigns on television networks to reach broad audiences.

product.name: Print Media Advertising
product.description: A service that manages advertising placements in newspapers, magazines, and other printed publications.

product.name: Digital Marketing
product.description: A service that handles online branding, marketing, and advertising across digital platforms.

product.name: Radio Marketing
product.description: A service that facilitates advertising campaigns on radio stations to reach targeted listener groups.

product.name: Out-of-Home (OOH) Advertising
product.description: A service that manages advertising placements on outdoor media such as billboards and transit displays.

product.name: Inflight Magazine Publishing
product.description: Publishing and distribution of the Spice Route inflight magazine for SpiceJet airline passengers.
